_week: 2026-11-09 to 2026-11-15 (Week 46). Written from this week's numbers.
week_story: Revenue rose 14% to $4,135 (from $3,617) on 89 units vs 83, and net payout tripled to $1,084 from $334 as ad spend fell 36% to $711.
Signature Kit led at $1,532 (17 units, vs $807); Essential Kit fell to $64 (1 unit) from $788 (13 units).
Cleaning Solution rose 83% to $761 (18 units vs 10); Waterproof Spray slipped 16% to $399.
refunds: Refunds were $8.70 on 1 unit (1.1% of orders), vs $0 the week before.
The one refund was an Odor Eliminator; nothing points to a product problem.
